scripts.typecheck: bun run tsc --noEmit && echo 'Type check passed ✅'
scripts.test: bun tests/utils/check-test-ready.ts && bun test tests/unit tests/integration tests/e2e/happy-path-e2e.test.ts tests/e2e/rollback-improved-1-e2e.test.ts && bun tests/unit/cleanup-after-tests.ts
scripts.test:unit: bun tests/unit/cleanup-after-tests.ts && bun test tests/unit && bun tests/unit/cleanup-after-tests.ts
scripts.pre-test: bun run test:e2e:check && bun run pre-test:cleanup
scripts.pre-test:cleanup: rm -rf tests/test-area && mkdir -p tests/test-area && rm -rf tests/test-results && mkdir -p tests/test-results && echo '✅ Test area and results cleaned'
